name: Date range picker
summary: Pick a start and end day from two months side by side, or one quick range such as last 7 days, then apply it to a report.
use: for filtering a report or table by dates
a11y: Every day is a button with its full date as its label and aria-pressed on the start and end; today has aria-current, future days are disabled, and the range length is announced in a polite live region.

use_when: a past period for analytics or billing, where days after today must not be picked
avoid_when: picking one date or a travel date in the future: future days are disabled here; use trip-search
choosing several filters at once, of which dates are only one: use filter-bar and open this from it
seeing what happens on each day: use calendar-agenda

parts.name: presets
parts.what: one quick range, such as Last 7 days; the last is Custom

parts.name: start
parts.what: the chosen start day, or a prompt to pick one

parts.name: end
parts.what: the chosen end day, or a prompt to pick one

parts.name: months
parts.what: one month: its name, previous and next buttons, and a grid of days; two side by side when wide

parts.name: days
parts.what: one day button: start, end, in range, today or disabled

parts.name: summary
parts.what: the range length and the time zone, or what to do next

empty.how: with only a start or no day picked, the open field shows 'Pick a day' in a muted colour with a focus border and the summary says what to do

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a range is too long for the report, put a warning line in the summary and set disabled on Apply

disabled.how: days after today and the next-month button past today are greyed out and cannot be pressed

overflow.how: below 600 px one month shows instead of two, and the presets move from a side column to a wrapping row, then two columns

long_text.how: the start and end fields cut a long date off with an ellipsis; preset labels never wrap
long_text.evidence: white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis

keyboard: Tab moves through the preset buttons, previous and next month, every day that is not disabled, then Cancel and Apply
Enter or Space on a day picks the start, then the end; focus stays on that day
Enter or Space on a preset sets its range and shows its months
The range length is read out by a polite live region after each pick
